title: Mexicali ULI indicator results row
description: One row of a *_results.csv file: the value of one measure for one unit of one reporting geography. The CSV is a long (tidy) table; this schema describes a single row of it.

indicator_id.description: The '#' of the parent indicator in the ULI workbook

indicator_code.description: Stable snake_case slug for the parent indicator

measure_id.description: Unique slug of the form <indicator_code>__<lens>[_<parameter>], matching a measure declared in the indicator metadata

geo_id.description: Unit identifier exactly as supplied in the reference geopackage (CVEGEO for ageb and manzana)

value.description: The measured value. Null only where quality_flag is suppressed, not_applicable or no_data.

denominator.description: Population, area (m2) or other denominator underlying the value; the type is declared per measure in the metadata

native_scale.description: The geography at which the measure was actually computed, before any aggregation or replication

coverage.description: Share of the unit (by population or area, as declared per measure) with valid input data
